title: SerenityMC
body:
This is the unofficial modpack for the Serenity Server!!

Modpack contains serveral QOL mods as well as comestic mods.
Xearo's Minimap and World Map included :D
Shader support included as well, with Euphoria Patches and Complementary Shaders preinstalled.

The main purpose of this modpack is for new players of SerenityMC to have a quick and easy way to get started with some QOL mods. The modpack is also updated after every major updates so after Serenity updates you can hop back in with an up-to-date modpack.

Server IP: **play.serenitymc.uk**              
Request Whitelist for Server: **join.serenitymc.uk**

This Modpack includes **voxy**, found here --> https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy
